binaries_from_source.name: flannel
binaries_from_source._note: scripts/build_flannel.sh at the tag: GO_LDFLAGS='-extldflags "-static" -w' plus VERSION_FLAGS -X main.Version=${VERSION} -X main.Commit=${COMMIT:0:8} -X main.Program=flannel, tags 'netgo osusergo no_stage static_build', CGO_ENABLED=1 on amd64, the main package at the repo root. scripts/version.sh sets VERSION="${GIT_TAG:0:6}" (git describe), so upstream's binary reports v1.9.1, not v1.9.1-flannel3: @VERSION:6@ is the same cut. Run without CNI_COMMAND, the plugin prints `CNI Plugin flannel version v1.9.1 (linux/amd64) commit b380f201` and the CNI versions it supports to stderr and exits 0 (CNI skel), which is the verify step.
